status.en: 5 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 62% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Fallujah.
status.nb: 5 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 62 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Fallujah.

summary.en: Protests in Iraq have turned deadly, with four people killed and many wounded, while armed factions such as Kata'ib Hezbollah threaten to join a war if Iran is attacked and accuse the Iraqi prime minister and coordination framework of corruption in the PMF law. Iran has launched missile strikes in Iraq and Syria, prompting US condemnation and statements of readiness to assist Erbil, and Iran is developing a missile capable of reaching Europe. The Iraqi prime minister ordered increased power and fuel supplies to Kirkuk, and energy deals with Iran involving Iraq and Pakistan were signed as Tehran flexes Hormuz control. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Protestene i Irak har blitt dødelige, med fire personer drept og mange såret, mens væpnede fraksjoner som Kata'ib Hezbollah truer med å delta i en krig dersom Iran blir angrepet og anklager Iraks statsminister og koordineringsrammeverket for korrupsjon i loven om PMF. Iran har gjennomført missilangrep i Irak og Syria, noe som har ført til amerikansk fordømmelse og uttalelser om beredskap til å bistå Erbil, og Iran utvikler en missil som kan nå Europa. Iraks statsminister beordret økt strøm- og drivstoffforsyning til Kirkuk, og energikontrakter med Iran som involverer Irak og Pakistan ble signert mens Teheran viser sin kontroll over Hormuz. UCDP registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
